description: Seven smoothed random voltage generators sharing one main rate, each with its own multiplier, voltage range and pull towards a chosen point

params.text: Sets the main rate; the tooltip reads it in hertz, from 2Hz fully anticlockwise to 10000Hz fully clockwise
Multiplies or divides that track's rate against the main rate, from a twenty-first of it to twenty-one times it, with the centre position matching
Sets one end of that track's voltage range, -10V to +10V; if it is set above the max knob the two swap over
Sets the other end of that track's voltage range, -10V to +10V; if it is set below the min knob the two swap over
Chooses which end of that track's range the random values are pulled towards: the lower end, the middle or the upper end
Sets how strongly that track's values are pulled towards the chosen point, 0% leaving them evenly random and 100% pinning them to it

inputs.text: Moves the main rate, a tenth of its voltage scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the RATE knob
Strengthens that track's pull towards its chosen point, a tenth of its voltage added to that track's str knob

outputs.text: That track's smoothed random voltage, between its min and max knobs; the bottom one can carry all seven as a polyphonic cable instead

menu: Polyphony on 7th out: Monophonic, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 — sets how many tracks the bottom output gathers into one polyphonic cable
Integer * — sets the seven x knobs to successive whole-number multiples of the main rate
Integer / — sets the seven x knobs to successive whole-number divisions of the main rate
Even * — sets the seven x knobs to even-numbered multiples of the main rate
Even / — sets the seven x knobs to even-numbered divisions of the main rate
Odd * — sets the seven x knobs to odd-numbered multiples of the main rate
Odd / — sets the seven x knobs to odd-numbered divisions of the main rate
Prime * — sets the seven x knobs to prime-numbered multiples of the main rate
Prime / — sets the seven x knobs to prime-numbered divisions of the main rate
Fibonacci * — sets the seven x knobs to Fibonacci multiples of the main rate
Fibonacci / — sets the seven x knobs to Fibonacci divisions of the main rate
Set all min/max range to: 0v/1v, 0v/5v, 0v/10v, 5v/10v, -5v/5v, -1v/1v, -1v/0v, -5v/0v, -10v/0v — sets every track's min and max knobs to the pair you pick
